name: agentic-sdk-editor
description: Phase 5 圖形編排 UI:拖曳設計、即時動畫、對話框輸出。後端走 Agentic SDK Gateway。

scripts.prestart: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
